title: Current baseline, where the code is, who did what
summary: The ooDialog Designer writes ooDialog programs in ooRexx from a drag-and-drop form, in the manner of VisPro/REXX, VX-REXX and DrDialog. Architecture: Tom Dyer. Code: Claude (Opus 5.5); the Database Lab: ChatGPT. It runs in a browser on ooDialog/WASM and Josep Maria Blasco's ooRexx/WASM 0.2.4; the programs it writes are plain upstream ooDialog for Windows. Published: packages/oorexx_oodialog_designer_v0.7, v0.8 (plugins), v0.9 (bound dialogs), v0.10 (reference picker, list Add/Remove, row fields) v0.11 (closed-first event tree, code marks, All code, trace probes that keep SIGL and RESULT; after feedback from Rony G. Flatscher and Josep Maria Blasco) v0.12 (ChatGPT's Database Lab graph merged; object lines filled for bound designs) and v0.13 (Rexx Parser 20261115: CATCH and FINALLY in the graph; runtime guard) in animatedads/alchemy; working branch oodialog-designer in animatedads/oorexx (folder oodialog-designer/, mirror of the Object Editor in object-editor/). Branch head after v0.13: 7af64f6.
invariants: Check packages/ on a fresh pull of alchemy main before choosing a version number: a version that exists is never reused.
Every class has module_version and module_lastChanged.
Every update names the architect (Tom Dyer), the coder (Claude (Opus 5.5) or ChatGPT) and the model writing it.
Do not work in Autobuild's checkout; submit with tools/alchemy_submit.py.
The Database Lab is ChatGPT's lane (oorexx_oodialog_database_lab); the designer, plugins and bound dialogs are Claude's. Changes across lanes go by Falcon request.
A package and its sphere go together: change this sphere in the same piece of work as the package, so other chats are not left to guess.
